question: After correcting provider-neutral Pump-family classification, does PRE_MIGRATION_RUNNER_WATCH produce at least one independent mint episode per covered hour and durable realizable paper outcomes under a Helius-only runtime feed?

priorEvidence.interpretation: V6 remains valid transport evidence, but its strategy evidence is unusable because Helius Pump.fun sources were routed through vendor-specific non-Pump branches. V7 starts a future-only evidence window after the classifier and semantic-health correction.

correctionScope.sourceCause: The isPumpPortalToken classifier excluded helius_logs_* and helius_pumpfun_* Pump.fun sources.
allowedChanges: replace vendor-specific Pump classification with provider-neutral Pump-family classification
reuse the existing rolling Pump trade-window calculation for Helius runtime events
emit semantic-health fields on existing Helius runtime trade telemetry
validate classified trades, positive rolling activity, decision propagation, and zero Helius-to-non-Pump misroutes

providerPlan.coverageSemantics: Time counts only after a current Helius subscription acknowledgement and excludes disconnected or transport-gap intervals.

episodeIdentity: telemetry_run|mint; same-mint reentries within a run count as one episode

throughputCheckpoint.gradeOn: cumulative future-only valid V7 Helius Pump-family sessions

requirements: realized PnL after removing top 3 winning episodes > 0
no single run contributes more than 60% of total positive PnL

prohibitions: No live broadcast enablement from this experiment.
No entry-gate, exit-rule, or provider-coverage changes while evidence is collecting.
No grading on MFE, maximum excursion, or duplicate same-mint reentries.
V1 through V6 rows cannot count as V7 evidence.
PumpPortal and PumpDev runtime events invalidate a V7 run rather than becoming fallback evidence.
Any strategy, threshold, provider, coverage, semantic-health, or exit change starts a new pre-registration.
A config-hash, source-fingerprint, missing-Git-commit, or dirty-working-tree mismatch excludes the run from V7 evidence.
